Deux vulnérabilités majeures détectées p: Two major vulnerabilities detected by artificial intelligence in PHP
Ce mardi vingt octobre deux mille vingt-: This Tuesday, October 20, 2026, two critical flaws were identified in the PHP programming language, which is used by approximately seventy percent of websites worldwide. This omnipresence has caused a real headache for the global internet, forcing certain players such as Orange to temporarily suspend access to some of its sites and applications as a precautionary measure. OpenAI has described this discovery as one of the most consequential vulnerabilities of recent years, highlighting the beginning of a phase where artificial intelligence can spot flaws on an internet-wide scale.
Jason Clinton, responsable adjoint de la: Jason Clinton, Deputy Chief Information Security Officer at Anthropic, indicates that the situation will get much worse before it gets better. He estimates that a period of about eighteen months will be necessary to resolve the current imbalance between the detection capabilities of artificial intelligence and the reactivity of companies facing these threats. Eventually, developers should use artificial intelligence to identify vulnerabilities as soon as software is designed.
